+++ b/tests/test_merge_config_regression.py
@@ -0,0 +1,122 @@
+import copy
+
+from config import merge_config
+
+
+def test_simple_override_preserved():
+    assert merge_config({"a": 1}, {"a": 2, "b": 3}) == {"a": 2, "b": 3}
+    assert merge_config({}, {}) == {}
+
+
+def test_returns_mapping_type():
+    result = merge_config({"a": 1}, {"b": 2})
+    assert isinstance(result, dict)
+
+
+def test_all_keys_from_base_and_overrides():
+    result = merge_config({"a": 1, "b": 2}, {"b": 20, "c": 30})
+    assert result == {"a": 1, "b": 20, "c": 30}
+
+
+def test_keys_only_in_base_preserved():
+    result = merge_config({"only_base": 1}, {"other": 2})
+    assert result["only_base"] == 1
+
+
+def test_keys_only_in_overrides_included():
+    result = merge_config({"a": 1}, {"only_override": 2})
+    assert result["only_override"] == 2
+
+
+def test_nested_mappings_merged_recursively():
+    base = {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 5432}}
+    overrides = {"db": {"port": 6543, "user": "admin"}}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result == {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 6543, "user": "admin"}}
+
+
+def test_override_wins_at_leaf():
+    base = {"a": {"b": {"c": 1}}}
+    overrides = {"a": {"b": {"c": 2}}}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result["a"]["b"]["c"] == 2
+
+
+def test_deeply_nested_merge():
+    base = {"a": {"b": {"c": 1, "d": 2}}}
+    overrides = {"a": {"b": {"c": 9}}}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result == {"a": {"b": {"c": 9, "d": 2}}}
+
+
+def test_lists_are_replaced_not_concatenated():
+    base = {"items": [1, 2, 3]}
+    overrides = {"items": [4, 5]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert result["items"] == [4, 5]
+
+
+def test_list_replacement_does_not_concatenate():
+    base = {"items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"items": [3]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert len(result["items"]) == 1
+    assert result["items"] == [3]
+
+
+def test_does_not_mutate_base():
+    base = {"a": 1, "nested": {"x": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(base)
+    merge_config(base, {"a": 2, "nested": {"y": 2}, "items": [9]})
+    assert base == snapshot
+
+
+def test_does_not_mutate_overrides():
+    overrides = {"a": 2, "nested": {"y": 2}, "items": [9]}
+    snapshot = copy.deepcopy(overrides)
+    merge_config({"a": 1, "nested": {"x": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}, overrides)
+    assert overrides == snapshot
+
+
+def test_result_shares_no_nested_objects_with_base():
+    base = {"nested": {"x": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    result = merge_config(base, {})
+    assert result["nested"] is not base["nested"]
+    assert result["items"] is not base["items"]
+
+
+def test_result_shares_no_nested_objects_with_overrides():
+    overrides = {"nested": {"y": 2}, "items": [9]}
+    result = merge_config({}, overrides)
+    assert result["nested"] is not overrides["nested"]
+    assert result["items"] is not overrides["items"]
+
+
+def test_mutating_result_does_not_affect_inputs():
+    base = {"nested": {"x": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"nested": {"y": 2}, "items": [9]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    result["nested"]["z"] = 3
+    result["items"].append(99)
+    assert base == {"nested": {"x": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    assert overrides == {"nested": {"y": 2}, "items": [9]}
+
+
+def test_mutating_inputs_does_not_affect_result():
+    base = {"nested": {"x": 1}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"nested": {"y": 2}, "items": [9]}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    base["nested"]["x"] = 100
+    base["items"].append(100)
+    overrides["nested"]["y"] = 200
+    overrides["items"].append(200)
+    assert result == {"nested": {"x": 1, "y": 2}, "items": [9]}
+
+
+def test_nested_result_is_independent_mapping():
+    base = {"a": {"b": 1}}
+    overrides = {"a": {"c": 2}}
+    result = merge_config(base, overrides)
+    assert isinstance(result["a"], dict)
+    assert result["a"] is not base["a"]
+    assert result["a"] is not overrides["a"]

contract_tests: merge_config(base, overrides) returns a mapping containing all keys from base and overrides -> test_all_keys_from_base_and_overrides asserts result == {"a": 1, "b": 20, "c": 30}.

When a key exists in both and both values are mappings, the result is a recursive merge -> test_nested_mappings_merged_recursively asserts result == {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 6543, "user": "admin"}} and test_deeply_nested_merge asserts result == {"a": {"b": {"c": 9, "d": 2}}}.
At leaf keys, the override value wins -> test_override_wins_at_leaf asserts result["a"]["b"]["c"] == 2.
Keys present only in overrides are included -> test_keys_only_in_overrides_included asserts result["only_override"] == 2.
Keys present only in base are preserved -> test_keys_only_in_base_preserved asserts result["only_base"] == 1.

Lists are replaced, not concatenated -> test_lists_are_replaced_not_concatenated asserts result["items"] == [4, 5] and test_list_replacement_does_not_concatenate asserts len(result["items"]) == 1 and result["items"] == [3].
The result does not mutate the base input mapping -> test_does_not_mutate_base asserts base == snapshot after the call.
The result does not mutate the overrides input mapping -> test_does_not_mutate_overrides asserts overrides == snapshot after the call.

The result shares no nested mutable objects with base or overrides -> test_result_shares_no_nested_objects_with_base asserts result["nested"] is not base["nested"] and result["items"] is not base["items"]; test_result_shares_no_nested_objects_with_overrides asserts result["nested"] is not overrides["nested"] and result["items"] is not overrides["items"]; test_nested_result_is_independent_mapping asserts result["a"] is not base["a"] and result["a"] is not overrides["a"].

Mutating the result does not affect either input -> test_mutating_result_does_not_affect_inputs asserts base == {"nested": {"x": 1}, "items": [1, 2]} and overrides == {"nested": {"y": 2}, "items": [9]} after mutating result.

Mutating base or overrides after the call does not affect the previously returned result -> test_mutating_inputs_does_not_affect_result asserts result == {"nested": {"x": 1, "y": 2}, "items": [9]} after mutating both inputs.

Simple (non-nested) overrides continue to work as before -> test_simple_override_preserved asserts merge_config({"a": 1}, {"a": 2, "b": 3}) == {"a": 2, "b": 3} and merge_config({}, {}) == {}; test_returns_mapping_type asserts isinstance(result, dict).

edits.old:
def merge_config(defaults, overrides):
    result = dict(defaults)
    result.update(overrides)
    return result

patches.rationale: The original merge_config is shallow: it copies the top-level dict and updates with overrides, so nested mappings are not merged and nested objects are shared with inputs. The failing test shows overrides not winning at leaves (because the previous candidate's diff is not present in this baseline; the baseline itself is shallow). I rewrite merge_config to recursively merge nested dicts, let overrides win at leaves, deep-copy leaf values (including lists, which are replaced not concatenated), and build a fresh result so neither input is mutated and no nested objects are shared. I add a new regression test file (tests/test_merge_config_regression.py) since tests/test_contract.py is immutable.
